definitions.role: 0=positions1-3,1=4-7,2=8-11; historical encounter position is a training label only
definitions.phase: 0=first20%,1=middle60%,2=last20%; running legal deliveries BEFORE event divided by scheduled_overs*6; never actual final duration
definitions.balls_faced: Non-wide deliveries, including no-balls. DNB=null; observed zero-ball batter=0. Total BF=legal deliveries+no-ball deliveries for eligible innings.
definitions.parity: (batter_runs+extras-wide penalty1-no-ball penalty1-five-run penalty)%2; unsupported penalties excluded
definitions.boundary: 4/6 allowance from batter or bye/legbye/wide boundary, respecting runs.non_boundary. Extra-boundary inference follows recorded run breakdown; temporal order of boundary versus completed running is not recorded.
definitions.source_scope: Men ODI start>=2016-01-01; exclude no-results,D/L,DLS,VJD,non11rosters,superovers,unsupported events; explicit per-innings reasons
definitions.future_support: Global outcomes catalog includes future categories. Consumers MUST filter eligible innings date<cutoff first, decode active observed tuples, union fixed law-valid base and sort tuples. Never place prior mass across this global vocabulary.
definitions.decision_time: Post-toss/declared XI, before match; realised runs/BF/duration/positions are labels only. Metadata innings_order known post-toss; scheduled50 used standard evaluation.
definitions.ordering: Global player IDs sorted, outcome tuples lexicographically sorted; no fuzzy identity matching
